newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danske Bank 96 profit fall seen.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danske Bank 96 profit fall seen.

text.p: Analysts polled by Reuters in a survey released on Tuesday forecast on average lower full year 1996 pre-tax profits for Denmark's biggest bank Den Danske Bank than in 1995.

Eight international and domestic analysts forecast average profits before tax and extraordinary items of 4.800 billion crowns for Den Danske Bank in 1996, compared to 6.034 billion crowns in the previous year.
Den Danske Bank is due to announce its 1996 results on Thursday February 20.

Last August, Den Danske Bank posted first-half 1996 group pre-tax profits of 2.353 billion crowns, compared to 1995's interim 2.449 billion crown surplus and said it expected a better whole year 1996 core activities result than in the previous year.
Analysts expected falling average profits for all Denmark's four leading banks for 1996.
